_README: soc_alert_surface, with its connector inventory DECLARED and every connector healthy/Available. The default world does not serve the `connector_details?configured=true` / `connectors` reads, so a build turn that needs a connector discovers an empty or unanswered inventory and (correctly) asks or flags a capability gap -- which is right behaviour, but gives the build-delivery graders no buildable case. This variant pins a known INSTALLED set (FortiEDR, FortiGate, VirusTotal, FortiSIEM, SMTP, all Completed, none Disconnected) so a build that uses only these can actually be authored and offered. Pair: soc_alert_surface_disconnected (same set, FortiGate/ServiceNow Disconnected).
